name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
notes: No graceful stop exists. The server has no RCON or console commands, and its exe is a Windows GUI program with no console or window, so Ctrl+Break can't reach it and Basecamp ends it with a kill (that is why it needed Task Manager before). Started with -log it does get a console, but Ctrl+Break and closing that console also end it at once without saving, and after Ctrl+C it stops serving without saving or exiting. The world is as of the game's own last save, so stop it when nobody has played for a while. The server won't serve without an OwnerId in DedicatedServer.ini: it logs that the OwnerId is empty and keeps running doing nothing (Basecamp then shows it Running after the timer). OwnerId is your Player ID, from the bottom of the in-game Settings menu. It goes under [/Script/Dominion.DedicatedServerSettings] with ServerName, DefaultWorldName and AdminPassword (ASCII, CRLF). The first start writes Saved\Config\WindowsServer\DedicatedServer.ini; if it isn't there, create the WindowsServer folder and copy the values from Saved\Config\Linux\DedicatedServer.ini. The server's Saved\ folder is RSDragonwilds\Saved\ in the install folder; %LOCALAPPDATA%\RSDragonwilds\Saved\ belongs to the game client, so don't back that up for the server. Worlds are SaveGames\<world>.sav with a .sav.backup beside it. Each start renames the last log to RSDragonwilds-backup-<date>.log and starts a new RSDragonwilds.log. Besides UDP 7777 the server opens UDP 8888 (purpose unknown) and UDP 45453 (LAN discovery); a second server uses 7778. Needs 2 GB RAM plus 1 GB per player.
